criteria.criterion: Use Slack People/member directory interface (or report access blockers) without DMs/edits
criteria.final_justification: The agent demonstrably used the People/member directory and opened profiles while adhering to the constraint not to message or modify content. Baseline stands.

criteria.criterion: Use Slack workspace search (or report access blockers) without DMs/edits
criteria.final_justification: Despite the baseline scoring 0/2, visual evidence confirms the agent did use Slack workspace search and viewed public message results (no DMs/edits). Therefore the score should be increased to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Identify up to 12 accessible relevant members (or explain limitation)
criteria.final_justification: The workspace clearly had more than one relevant, accessible member visible, and even within the agent’s final support-filtered view there were 2. The agent reported only 1 and did not justify the limitation, so this is a controllable omission. Score should be reduced from the baseline partial credit.

criteria.criterion: Report only Slack-visible fields per person (and mark missing fields as not present)
criteria.final_justification: The agent included an incorrect Slack-visible field (misattributed title/role). While some fields (name, away, local time) are supported, the wrong title is a substantive accuracy error. Reduce score accordingly.

criteria.criterion: Provide one supporting public message reference when available (or explicitly note none accessible)
criteria.final_justification: A key part of the task was to provide a supporting public message reference when available. The environment shows such references were available via workspace search (screenshots 1-2), yet the agent did not provide any and claimed none were visible. That’s a controllable failure, so the baseline full score should be reduced.

criteria.criterion: Group members by likely area of expertise and mark unclear classifications
criteria.final_justification: The required grouping/categorization was not done at all in the final output. Keep at zero.
